label: Loan or guarantee
definition: Public lending or loan guarantees to firms, farmers or households, including microcredit. Excludes grants and insurance.
aliases: Guarantee | Loan | Loan or guarantee | Loan, insurance

label: Health insurance
definition: A scheme that pools health costs, contributory or tax-funded, including national health insurance. Excludes direct provision of care.

label: Insurance
definition: A risk-pooling scheme other than health, such as crop, livestock or disaster insurance. Excludes health insurance and loans.

label: Fund
definition: A dedicated public fund set up or capitalised for a purpose. Excludes general budget allocations.

label: Public-private partnership
definition: A contract in which a private party finances or runs a public asset or service. Excludes procurement and outsourcing.

label: Bond
definition: A bond issued to finance a purpose, such as a green bond. Excludes general borrowing.

label: Information system or platform
definition: A digital platform, database or information system built or upgraded. Excludes registers of people or assets.
aliases: Information system | Information system or platform | Platform

label: Register
definition: A register of people, firms, land or assets, such as a cadastre or social registry. Excludes general information systems.

label: Facility or network built
definition: Building or expanding physical assets: roads, power lines, hospitals, centres, parks, zones. Excludes maintenance of what exists and buying services.
aliases: Facility | Facility or network | Facility or network to be built | Network | Network or facility

label: Law or regulation
definition: Enacting, amending or repealing a law or regulation, including licensing. Excludes standards and voluntary guidelines.

label: Standards
definition: Technical, quality or performance standards and their certification. Excludes laws and regulations in general.

label: Subsidy
definition: A payment or price support that lowers the cost of a good or input, including tariffs set below cost. Excludes cash transfers to households.

label: Payment for ecosystem services
definition: Payments to land users for conserving or restoring ecosystems. Excludes general environmental subsidies.

label: Tax or levy
definition: Raising or restructuring a tax or levy. Excludes tax incentives.

label: Tax incentive
definition: A tax exemption, credit or holiday to encourage an activity. Excludes tax increases.

label: Carbon pricing or market
definition: A carbon tax, emissions trading or carbon credit market. Excludes other environmental taxes.

label: Trade agreement
definition: A bilateral, regional or multilateral trade or investment agreement. Excludes unilateral trade measures.

label: Cash transfer
definition: Cash paid to households or individuals, conditional or not, including minimum income schemes. Excludes subsidies on goods.

label: Scholarship
definition: A grant to students to cover study costs. Excludes general education spending.
